articles.title: Notes
articles.summary: Keep short notes shared with everyone in your organization.
body: Open Notes in the header to see the notes of your organization, newest first. Type in Search and select Search to find notes by title.
Select New note, enter a title and the text, then select Save. Select a note to change it, or Delete to remove it.
If you see "Someone changed this note. Reload it and try again.", another person saved the note after you opened it. Reload the note, then make your change again.
